// Paints filled voxels with the selected colours in stripes, like noise: it
// only paints with the selection, so Rok starts it with a run of colours.
float map(vec3 v) {
  if (voxel(v) == 0.0) return 0.0;
  return color_sel(mod(floor(v.x), float(i_num_color_sels)));
}
